merchant/30063.htm.text: Grocer Lara: Welcome, friend! You won't recognize my store since we recently finished remodeling. We sell a variety of potions -- necessities for any serious adventurer. You look like someone who has an eye for quality, so just let me know what I can get for you...

links.text: View information about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30063-pk.htm.text: Grocer Lara: Get out of here! I don't do business with outlaws!!!

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30063-01.htm.text: Trader Lara: Jewels? Ah! You mean the one that I bought in Giran's gallery recently. It was for one of my patrons who is really into collecting empire antiques. The jewels are already in his hands...

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30063-03.htm.text: Trader Lara: I hope that Ismel is all right...

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30063-04.htm.text: Trader Lara: Poor Ismel... He didn't even get a proper burial... Such an upstanding person... how could he have turned into an undead? So strange! Do you suppose that it has something to do with the jewelry?
when: state STARTED; has items 3309,3314,3319; lacks items 3314; !(!hasQuestItems(player, AKLANTOTH_3RD_GEM) && hasQuestItems(player, LARAS_MEMO))

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30063-05.htm.text: Trader Lara: I am quite sure that the jewel you seek is an omen. If I were you, I would give it to the Highest Priest of Einhasad's shrine!
when: state STARTED; has items 3323,3324; lacks items 3309

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30063-01.html.text: Trader Lara: I know! You are the summons apprentice! Did you find me because you needed an arcana? I can make one for you... Although it won't be very good, it's just something I do as a pastime. It would be too embarrassing if I sold it for money. So how about an exchange? I'll make you a Beginner…

links.text: I will find you the things that you need.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30063-03.html.text: Trader Lara: You again! What do you want this time?

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30063-06.html.text: Trader Lara: You have found all the things that I asked for! Thank you so much. I shall lend you two Beginner's Arcanas as promised.

Q00299_GatherIngredientsForPie/30063-01..text: Trader Lara: Emily's imported spice just arrived. Here, take a sniff! Isn't it fragrant? As she requested, I ordered a wonderfully aromatic spice! She'll be able to bake a delicious pie!

Q00299_GatherIngredientsForPie/30063-03..text: Trader Lara: Why haven't you returned to Emily yet? Deliver it to her before the fragrance of the spice dissipates. She must be waiting, so please hurry!

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30063-02.htm.text: Trader Lara: Let's see... The records say it was sold by the village leather craftsman Ismell . He has been behaving strangely since he bought jewelry from our shop. He has been seen wandering around the village in the middle of the night, murmuring to himself in a strange voice. Then suddenly he d…

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30063-02.html.text: Trader Lara: Then I will write down the things that I need. If you can bring me what's written on the list, I will make you two Beginner's Arcanas. Okay, it's a deal.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30063-04.html.text: Trader Lara: Oh, I see! If that is so, let's do it just like the other day... You find me the things that I need, and I will make you some more Beginner's Arcanas. Here, I'll make a list of the things I need.

Q00299_GatherIngredientsForPie/30063-02..text: Trader Lara: The fruit aroma is pleasant, isn't it? The spice is specially imported! Please take it to Emily.
